evidence.claim: Charter added 406,000 mobile lines but lost 172,000 internet customers, while revenue fell 1.7%, adjusted EBITDA fell 4.3%, and free cash flow fell 7.4% to USD 969 million.
Charter ended the quarter with USD 93.8 billion principal debt and USD 509 million cash.
Comcast reported year-over-year improvement in broadband losses and record 448,000 wireless additions, reaching 10.2 million lines.
